  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MIT BLR - BTech VII Semester - End Semester Examination - Nov / Dec -2024  
  HUMAN COMPUTER INTERFACE [CSE-4069]  
  Marks: 50                                                                              Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           What is Human computer interface? Explain in detail goals and importance of HCI.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      What input and output devices would you use for the following systems? For each,  
  compare and contrast alternatives, and if appropriate indicate why the conventional  
  keyboard, mouse and CRT screen may be less suitable.                                        (5)  
  a) portable word processor  
  b) tourist information system  
  
  2)           How do you apply the following interaction styles in the interface development of the  
  bus ticket booking system? Explain.  
  a) Menus b) Form fills                                                                      (5)  
  A)      Discuss their benefits and drawbacks in HCI.  
  
  B)      A single CPU must be shared among multiple users to perform their tasks submitted to a  
  computer through the interface. Which paradigm best suits this context? Explain the    (5)  
  interaction paradigm along with its advantages and disadvantages.  
  
  3)           What is universal design in HCI? Explain in detail the different principles of universal  
  design.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Compare and contrast waterfall model and prototyping model for software development.  
  How do you incorporate HCI usability factor in these models?                         (5)  
  
  4)           Explain the different goals of evaluation. Why it is important to apply evaluation  
  techniques for HCI design? Discuss  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Discuss the different requirements of user support in HCI systems. Give any three  
  examples of user support.                                                                   (5)  
  
  5)           The developed product must be deployed in the organization for real-time operation.         (5)  
  However, organizational issues can break or make a system. Justify this statement with  
  proper reasons.
